_analysis_seed_note: Recorded 2026-09-21. This collector did not write the field, so every analysis of this run has inherited studypaths.LEGACY_SEED. The inherited value is written here rather than a date-derived one, because changing it would change what a re-analysis reproduces. Collectors now write their own.
_note: The SEEDS, orders, conditions and numbering arms are fixed by the pre-registration and were written here before the first call, so none of them can be chosen to suit a result. `models` and `provider_pins` record what was actually collected and were reconstructed from the records -- see _reconstructed, and Amendment 1 of the prereg for why each backend was chosen and what the per-backend omission split looks like.
_reconstructed: 2026-09-21. `models` and `provider_pins` are READ FROM THE RECORDS in this directory, because the collector wrote this file on its first invocation and never updated it: it named 2 model(s) over a directory holding 8. The arm is filled one model per call, each pinned to its own backend, so the first call's roster is not the run's roster. Fixed in run_omission_orders.py for future runs; this file could only be repaired from the data.
_roster_is_cumulative: This directory is filled one model per invocation, because each is pinned to its own backend. `models` is the union of every invocation so far and grows as they land -- it is NOT a roster fixed before the first call, and the pre-registration fixes the ORDERS, CONDITIONS and NUMBERING ARMS here, not which models were re-collected or onto which backend.
